author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before mixed outlined and solid shapes: a big ring, a thick donut, a tiny dot and a solid disc, so it read as a random dot pattern. Now all four are consistent rings (big top-left, small top-right, medium centre-right, and one at the bottom), each at least 8 apart, following the reference's arrangement.
omissions: Circle sizes are spread slightly from the reference's tight packing to keep 8-unit gaps; the smallest is an r3 ring.
